file.description:
The file that contains the links to be resolved.

This field is provided by DocumentationRenderer before starting to render links for a particular documentation
file.

title:
Type which provides context-specific target translation for a link from the user-specified value. Web links are
supported in most contexts, but type links need to be resolved in a context-specific way.

This type is not abstract because it provides default implementations, but they only handle web links and return
null for others. This means that internal link and image references will be replaced by their anchor text (no link
or image markup will be generated).

@see DocumentationRenderer
@see DocumentationRenderSpec
name: DocumentationLinkBuilder
